# Gladia

Gladia provides state-of-the-art audio transcription and intelligence services through a simple API, enabling real-time and asynchronous transcription, translation, and audio analysis.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gladia/.

## Actions

- **Get live transcription result** (read-only): Retrieve metadata and results of a live transcription job.
- **Get Pre-recorded Transcription Result** (read-only): Retrieve metadata for a pre-recorded transcription job.
- **Gladia List Pre-Recorded Transcriptions** (read-only): List pre-recorded transcription jobs with optional filters.
- **Initiate Live Transcription Session**: Initiate a live transcription session.
- **List live transcription jobs** (read-only): List live transcription jobs.
- **Upload Audio/Video File**: Upload an audio or video file to Gladia's servers.
- **Initiate Pre-Recorded Transcription**: Initiate a pre-recorded transcription job.
